about: The attack matrix's written table of who may do what (WORKLIST P0.77), read by e2e/db/attack/attack.mjs. Each public table and view of the snapshot has an entry (a view's rows are its tables', so laid: false); a table with none fails the run by name. owner: the column naming whose row it is, {via, on} for a row owned through another, or house for a row no member owns. specimen: the row each owner holds, laid down as the house. In a row, {owner} is the owner's id, {username} their handle, {id} the specimen's own id and {id#2} a second one, {ref:table} the owner's specimen in that table, {ref:table@V} another owner's, {uid@V} another owner's id, {peer} and {peer2} two bystanders, {admin} the admin, {private} whether the owner is the private member, {later} a month from now, {new} an id no row has. variant: what a new row changes so it is not the specimen again (none: the specimen is taken away and laid again). acrossBlocks: the others rules hold for BK and BY too; otherwise no write reaches across a block. touch: the change an update tries; forbidden: changes no one may make to any row, their own included. read: who sees another's row (everyone, members, viewable, viewable-members, owner, owner+admin, none). self and others: who may insert, update and delete their own rows and another member's (all, unbanned, ranked, rank1, rank2, admin, none; ranked asks the rank alone, rank1 and rank2 the rank and good standing). hidesBlocked: a member never sees the rows of one they blocked or who blocked them. reach: a row of one's own whose set columns point at another owner's row, and who may add it for each owner. functions: each function a visitor or member may run, its cases called as each kind of member named (all, members, or a list): expect ok or error (or ok only for a rule), a result rule over its answer as JSON ($1), and then, the house's reading of what it left. channels: each live channel as Realtime asks its rules, heard (a message on its topic read) or spoken on (presence or broadcast added). mutantsJudged: each mutant (attack.mjs --mutants) that no try notices, with why it changes nothing a member can do. probes: one attack each, with the answer it must get. why: the rule in words.

profiles.why: Every profile is seen; a member writes their own words on it, never their rank, standing, counts or address, and an account is made and closed only by the house.

films.why: The film catalogue is the house's, read by everyone.

founding_seat_counter.why: Only the house counts the hundred seats.

lobby_editions.why: The house hangs the wall; members read it.

lobby_withheld.why: Only the house withholds from the wall.

rank_grants.why: A rank is granted by the stores and the house, never written by a member.

lounge_sanctions.why: Kept by the house's moderation functions.

viewings.why: A log's viewings are kept by the house's triggers.

logs.why: A log is seen as its member's file is; a silenced member may still take theirs down.

lists.why: A stack is seen as its member's file is.

list_items.why: A stack's films are its member's.

watchlists.why: A watchlist is seen as its member's file is.

physical_archive.why: The Physical Archive is an Archivist feature; taking a piece down never is.

log_private_notes.why: The Vault's notes are their member's alone, and an Archivist feature; seen by no one else, so a ban that silences a member leaves them be.

log_counts.why: Kept by the house's triggers; read with the log.

log_comments.why: A critique is seen where its log is.

list_comments.why: A note on a stack is seen where its stack is.

interactions.why: A follow is made and undone, never changed. It is seen when either end's file is open, as a follower list is; every specimen follows an open member.

user_blocks.why: Whom a member blocks or mutes is theirs alone.

notifications.why: A member's notices are theirs; only the house writes one.

member_drafts.why: A draft is its member's alone.

push_tokens.why: A device's token is registered by the house's function; its member may take it down.

push_subscriptions.why: The website's abandoned web push, read by nothing: a member may add their own and see none, so cannot take one away.

analytics_events.why: An event is filed under its own member and read by no client.

error_logs.why: A member's error reports are theirs to file and to read.

warnings.why: The house's word to a member: written by an admin, read by its member and the admins, acknowledged by its member.

mod_actions.why: The record of the house's acts: written by an admin, read by the admins and the member it names.

reports.why: A report is filed by submit_report and read by its reporter and the admins.

lounges.why: Every salon is discoverable by members; opening one is an Archivist feature, and its name and words are speech a ban silences.

lounge_members.why: A seat is taken through the house's functions; its member moves their reading place and may leave.

lounge_messages.why: A salon's words are read by members when it is open and by its seats when private; said once, never changed.

lounge_message_reactions.why: Read as the salon's words are; a seated member reacts.

dispatch_posts.why: A filing is the Dispatch's, read by everyone; filing is an Auteur feature; a filing is withdrawn through the house, never deleted, so its critiques keep their place.

dispatch_votes.why: A vote is secret; cast once.

dispatch_saves.why: What a member saves is theirs alone.

dispatch_dossiers_legacy.why: The old Dispatch's dossiers, read by everyone and written by nothing: an older build's dossier reaches dispatch_posts through the dispatch_dossiers view.

dossier_comments_legacy.why: The old Dispatch's comments, read by everyone and written by nothing: an older build's comment reaches dispatch_comments through the dossier_comments view.

dossier_certifications_legacy.why: The old Dispatch's certifications, read by everyone and written by nothing: an older build's certification reaches dispatch_certifications through the dossier_certifications view.

storage.objects.why: The avatars bucket: each member's pictures in a folder of their own id. Everyone sees a picture at the bucket's public address; through the table a member reads, adds, replaces and takes away only their own. Each try is made as the Storage API makes it, its own flag set (Supabase refuses a delete without it).

dispatch_dossiers.why: The old name of the Dispatch's essays, kept for older builds' queued writes: every rule of dispatch_posts holds through it.

dossier_comments.why: The old name of the Dispatch's critiques: every rule of dispatch_comments holds through it.

dossier_certifications.why: The old name of the Dispatch's certifications: every rule of dispatch_certifications holds through it.

can_endorse_content.why: A gate of certifications: a private member's log answers only its readers.

create_lounge.why: Opening a salon is an Archivist feature, a private one an Auteur's; a ban silences.

dispatch_room_totals.why: A member's published filings, as public as they are.

get_profile_counts.why: A file's counts: a private member's only to its readers (followers counted for all).

get_public_profile_analytics.why: A file's figures: a member reads a private one's only as its follower.

get_taste_profile.why: A file's taste: a private member's only to its readers.

hidden_authors.why: Those the caller blocked or muted, and those who blocked them: no one else's.

list_certify_counts.why: Stacks' certifications: a private stack's only to its owner.

probes.name: a private member who opens their file lets in those who asked
probes.then: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.interactions WHERE id = '{new}' AND type = 'follow')
probes.why: Going open turns every waiting request into a follow (handle_privacy_switch): no one is left asking at an open door.

probes.name: a second interaction within a second is refused
probes.why: A member's interactions are kept a second apart (check_interaction_rate_limit), against floods.

probes.name: a member's 201st error report of a day is refused
probes.laySql: INSERT INTO public.error_logs (user_id, error_type, error_message, created_at) SELECT '{owner}', 'rh', 'rh', now() FROM generate_series(1, 200)
probes.why: A member's error reports are kept to 200 a day (20261015_07).
